title.narrative: Improve access of vulnerable communities in South Kordofan in Food Security

description.narrative: ltpgtNearly ten months after fighting erupted in Sudan, civilian displacement continues across the country. An estimated 8.1 million people have fled their homes since the conflict between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) started in mid-April 2023. As reported by the International Organization for Migration (OIM) on March 12, 2024, 6.4 million people have sought refuge within Sudan and 1.9 mln in neighbouring countries. Fleeing from conflict in the larger Sudan, the Two Regions have seen a large influx of IDPs, with a total of 572,202 IDPs as of March 8, 2024.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtEssential humanitarian aid will be provided to the IDPs who have fled from Sudan into areas controlled by the Sudan People's Liberation Movement-North (SPLM-N) in the framework of the conflict that broke out on April 15, 2023. DanChurchAid (DCA) intends to address the food needs through CVA and FSL programming. The project will be implemented with a conflict sensitivity approach, ensuring “do no harm”, especially focusing on sensitization of host communities and IDPs by targeting both groups to mitigate conflict and foster peaceful-co existence. In total, 108,570 people will directly benefit from the proposed support. In total 15,200 men, 32,571 women, 30,400 boys and 30,400 girls in 4 counties will receive support.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtSectors:ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtCASH AND VOUCHER ASSISTANCE (CVA): ltbrgtDCA proposes to support communities with a high influx of IDPs with group cash transfers. For the specific funding, DCA and its implementing partners will focus on the Food security approach. Communities will be provided with training and guidance on how to present their proposal and budget to the partners. Once approved the groups are provided with the cash grant that the group is responsible for utilizing according to the plan. The groups are monitored closely by implementing partner community volunteers. DCA proposes to support 47 community groups with 4,000 USD per group. The groups will be located in areas with a high influx of IDPs (Habila and Western Kadugli) and involve both IDPs and host community members. This is expected to reduce the conflict among the IDP and host communities and promote social cohesion. The average groups is estimated 20 people per group.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtFOOD SECURITY AND LIVELIHOODS:ltbrgt- DCA proposes to support 6,400 IDP and host community households with seed kits and agro-tools to increase the food diversity, self-sustainability, and production of the vulnerable households. The seeds and agro-tools will also allow households to sell the fruits- and vegetables in the local market and provide income. The seeds and agro-tools will be provided to the communities with a high influx of IDPs coordinated with other humanitarian actors.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgt- In order to reduce the impact of conflict at the community level and improve food security self-reliance and resilience for conflict-affected populations, DCA is planning to conduct livestock vaccination campaigns in South Kordofan in Dellami and Abbasiya counties. This is intended to contribute to the development of livestock vertically by raising the productive efficiency of the animal by improving its genetic characteristics and providing high-production breeds or horizontally by increasing the number of existing animals. This activity also strives to address a conflict trigger among the communities by reducing the livestock mortality rate and hindering further local disputes over livestock ownership. The budgeted amount for this activity will cover the procurement of the vaccines, transportation (cold chain), and application by qualified staff in the prioritized regions. In total 30,000 cattle, 44,000 sheep and goats, and 50,000 poultry are planned to be vaccinated. Community-Based Animal Health Workers training is planned to be conducted to 50 volunteers involved in the campaign. Total of 12,400 households(68,200 individuals) should benefit from the support.lt/pgt
